global_instructions: You are writing sections of a financial advice report addressed to the client. Write in clear British English, in the first person ('we'). Output only the text for the section itself, with no extra headings or commentary. Where a figure requires human review before the report is sent to the client, mark it exactly as: [TBC - REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW]. Use this marker consistently for any fee rates, tax figures, or other values that must be confirmed by a person. Never estimate or invent figures that have not been provided in the source data.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.template:
Further to our recent discussions, we are writing to set out our advice in relation to <<scope>>. This advice is based on the information currently available to us.

This firm is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.

scope.prompt: Use accounts_in_scope from the provided facts and output it as a short phrase in the format 'your [account name]'. Output only that phrase, nothing else. No sentences, no punctuation at the end.

sections.title: Background & Objectives
sections.template:
<<summary>>

The accounts covered by this report are as follows:

<<holdings_table>>

summary.prompt: Write a concise background summary of exactly 2 sentences. Mention the client's current circumstances, whether their objectives have changed, and their agreed risk profile. Use only the provided facts. Write naturally in clear British English. Do not invent details.

holdings_table.prompt: Output ONLY a markdown table, nothing else. No introductory text, no sentences before or after. Columns: Account | Owner | Type | Value. Include ONLY the Stocks & Shares ISA account from the provided accounts facts. Use exact values from the facts formatted as £52,000.

sections.title: Tax Implications
sections.use_if: Only include if the recommendation involves selling investments or disposing of existing investments.

cgt_statement.prompt: State that the disposal may give rise to a capital gains tax liability, assessed against the client's annual exempt amount. Do NOT estimate or invent any figures. Flag clearly as [TBC - REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW].

fees.prompt: Set out the ongoing fees and charges that apply to the client's investments. DO NOT invent or estimate any fee rates. Mark the platform charge rate and ongoing advice charge rate as [TBC - REQUIRES HUMAN REVIEW] as these must be confirmed by a person before the report is sent to the client.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.template:
The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invest. Past performance is not a guide to future returns.

If you are happy to proceed with our recommendations, please let us know and we will implement them for you.
